members.method: Ownership follows the current human assignee; tasks an AI member handles on someone's behalf count for whoever dispatched them, and unattributable or former members are listed separately. Work items are de-duplicated by ID. The window covers tasks created, or with events or run activity, inside the selected period. Completed follows the board definition — delivered successfully within the period; in progress, not started and awaiting your call or acceptance reuse the board buckets (IN_PROGRESS, NEW, PENDING_DECISION) with tasks completed in the period removed, so the four columns are mutually exclusive. The task total also drops cancelled tasks, so it can exceed the sum of the four columns. Only REQ counts as requirement delivery. Times are Beijing time.

stages.title: Stage duration
stages.filtersFailure: The filter options failed to load; please retry.
stages.empty: No stage records in this range. Adjust the dates or filters.
stages.scope: Samples are picked by run creation date (Beijing time). Squads filter by their current members; each run counts separately, so one work item may appear several times.
stages.coverageDetail: {{missing}} of the observed stages lack a start record. Runs without step events, or that cannot be located in the flow, do not count towards coverage.
stages.method: Cumulative duration covers the model, tools, checks and waiting inside a step; a rerun accumulates only the intervals actually spent, and gaps between steps are excluded. Mean, P50 and P90 cover completed stages that have a start record; running, incomplete, reused and skipped stages are shown separately, and missing data is never counted as zero.
stages.slowestNote: Each stage shows its ten slowest runs. Missing durations show “—”; open a work item to see that run's stage records.
